SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 43.250795, -76.719468 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description
CALLER STATED THAT THEY HAD A PRIVATE COMPANY CONDUCTED A $2500 AIR MONITORING TEST AT A PRIVATE RESIDENCE IN DEC2012 AFTER THEY HAD GOTTEN PROGRESSIVELY ILL THROUGHOUT THE TIME THAT THEY RESIDED THERE BETWEEN SEPT2000 - NOV2011. CALLER STATED THAT THEY NO LONGER LIVE AT THE RESIDENCE BUT STILL GO BACK TO THE LOCATION TO CHECK ON THE HOUSE AND ON 30MAR2012, TWO DOGS BECAME ILL AND WERE THROWING UP AND TWO FEMALES BECAME ILL WITH SYMPTOMS OF DIZZINESS AND THERE WAS A STRONG PETROCHEMICAL SMELL IN THE AIR.
